Hidden gem
Oct 2026 • Family
Hidden away on a side street lives a quaint little restaurant. It is cozy, friendly and the waitress speaks good English. We were on our way to our flat to collect our back packs and the kind Ady said she could take our order and have our food ready for when we got back. 
We had Bun Cha which was absolutely delicious so so tasty and amazing value for money at one 88k VND I would 100% come back here if we came again. Fabulous 😍
